notes.title: Markiplier Thank You Update And Sale
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=yVq3MQSUNmk;full]https://youtu.be/yVq3MQSUNmk[/previewyoutube]

Thanks to Markiplier for being the first person to ever try the game out and provide some feedback!  We are working on updates that will include boss battles, more events to add excitement, and an improved gameplay loop thanks to his suggestions in his video titled "I Let a Sketchy Website Pick a Random Steam Game for Me to Play" so check that out if you're interested to laugh at our mistakes!  Hopefully, we can improve Earth Attack to be worthy of his glorious positive review!

Let us know what sort of changes you'd like to see to the game and we will do our best to implement them soon.  Also, don't forget to check out some of our other prototypes that are all currently on sale for 80% Off Until September 4th!

https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=PTW%20Inc.
